entryCases.name: p110_cert_mixed_string

entryCases.name: p110_cert_nat

entryCases.name: p110_cert_u32
entryCases.reason: Scalar representation must not be inferred as an owning Term from erased arity.

entryCases.name: p110_cert_lookalike
entryCases.reason: A same-shape user datatype has different checked constructor provenance.

entryCases.name: p110_cert_alias

entryCases.name: p110_cert_dependent

entryCases.name: p110_cert_higher_order
entryCases.reason: A closure input cannot be treated as an owning data word.

entryCases.name: p110_cert_function_result
entryCases.reason: Declared source arity is one; a function result is not another source parameter.

entryCases.name: nt_reverse

entryCases.name: p110_cert_closed_reverse
